description.text: Stop Gender Trafficking of Minors Act

latestAction.text: Referred to the Committee on the Judiciary, and in addition to the Committee on Oversight and Government Reform, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.

bill.title: Stop Gender Trafficking of Minors Act

aiDescription.summary: The bill criminalizes knowingly transporting a minor across state or foreign lines to obtain puberty blockers, cross‑sex hormones, or gender‑altering surgery, punishable by up to 10 years' imprisonment and civil suits. It also denies federal funds to governments that permit, facilitate, or fail to cooperate with investigations of such transport.

impact.summary: The bill criminalizes knowingly transporting a minor across state lines to obtain puberty blockers, cross‑sex hormones, or surgical sex‑change procedures, affecting parents and medical providers. It also bars federal funds to states or localities that allow such transport or refuse to cooperate with DOJ investigations.
